<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919434_theRebbe_712" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919434_theRebbe_712__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the natural milestone of becoming a man at thirteen must be actualized through one's own divine service, specifically drawing the essence of the intellect into the emotions.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is [the meaning of] "And you shall be strong and become a man,"</t>
    <t s="2">that this [fact] that a thirteen-year-old becomes a man by nature,</t>
    <t s="3">is a matter that comes from Above,</t>
    <t s="4">from the aspect that the Holy One, blessed be He, implanted nature in creation.</t>
    <t s="5">And since the primary virtue of any matter is when it comes through the service of man</t>
    <t s="6">(as explained above at length),</t>
    <t s="7">therefore it must be "And you shall be strong and become a man,"</t>
    <t s="8">that he should be a man</t>
    <t s="9">(also)</t>
    <t s="10">through his own service.</t>
    <t s="11">And based on this, we can also explain the precision of "And you shall be strong and become a man,"</t>
    <t s="12">for "man" indicates the emotions,</t>
    <t s="13">even though the virtue of a thirteen-year-old is in the intellects,</t>
    <t s="14">that he has the essence of the intellects which is above the matter of emotions,</t>
    <t s="15">for the virtue of man's service that reaches the essential thought is primarily in the service of drawing the essence of the intellects</t>
    <t s="16">(which is above the matter of emotions)</t>
    <t s="17">into the emotions,</t>
    <t s="18">in the manner explained above regarding the matter of Yosef, who draws the revelation of Atzilus</t>
    <t s="19">(which is above the root of created beings)</t>
    <t s="20">into BiYA.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section connects the maamar to the service of the Rebbe's father-in-law, Yosef of our generation, whose primary work was spreading the wellsprings outward as preparation for the coming of Moshiach.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And we can connect all this with the service of my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe,</t>
    <t s="1">Yosef of our generation,</t>
    <t s="2">that the maamar beginning "And you shall be strong and become a man" was said at the conclusion and seal of his Bar Mitzvah celebration,</t>
    <t s="3">[and] that his primary service was "Spread your wellsprings outward,"</t>
    <t s="4">that even in the most external "outside," below which there is no outside,</t>
    <t s="5">there should be drawn</t>
    <t s="6">(in addition to the waters that are drawn from the wellsprings,</t>
    <t s="7">also)</t>
    <t s="8">the wellsprings themselves.</t>
    <t s="9">And this</t>
    <t s="10">(the spreading of the wellsprings outward)</t>
    <t s="11">is the preparation and vessel for the imminent arrival, literally, of Master, the King Moshiach.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
